surface_mechanism_description: The reaction pathway involves the interaction of trimethylaluminum (TMA) with ozone (O3) on the graphite surface, leading to the formation of intermediate species such as carbonate, formate, and methoxy groups. The presence of these intermediates is attributed to incomplete reaction of TMA/O3 at low temperatures, resulting in the incorporation of contaminants into the dielectric film.
evidence: The appearance of an additional C 1 s state at 290 eV is attributed to intermediate species (carbonate, formate and methoxy) in the TMA / O3 reaction pathway.11 The total oxygen intensity is greater for the film deposited at 30 ° C than for the film deposited at 200 ° C. The appearance of an additional C 1 s state at 290 eV /H20851Fig. 1/H20849d/H20850/H20852 is also observed. These differences indicate that the composition of the deposited film is dependent on the substrate deposition temperature.
